Freshest and tastiest Vietnamese food
May 2026 • Friends
Co Hong is a welcoming family run restaurant opposite the Boutique Hotel. Hong is the most amazing cook and her husband Vu is the king of the chargrill. Try the crispy Vietnamese pancakes (absolutely the best in the whole of Vietnam), chargrilled prawns and scallops, spring rolls, fish in banana leaf, mango and papaya salad and many other dishes. We went back night after night. Hong goes to the market each morning to pick the food for the day so you know you are eating the freshest food possible. If you are staying in Hoi An, An Bang or surrounds, you must visit Co Hong.
